summary: Shedroof Mountain summit site in Pend Oreille County: camp 1915, cupola 1926, 30-foot pole tower 1938, removed in the 1950s. Footings remain, per Willhite's 2022 visit.

facts.design: 30-foot pole tower with L-4 cab (1938), replacing a 1926 cupola cabin
facts.status_note: Tower removed in the 1950s; four footings from the 1938 tower and a footing from the 1926 cupola cabin remain

access.note: Reached on foot by a trail from a north trailhead, via national forest roads; the pages read describe no closure or permit

visit.trail_note: Willhite gives 4 miles from the north trailhead with 1,100 feet of elevation gain; the trail runs the whole way

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Register says the 1938 tower was removed in the 1950s; Rex's page says destroyed in the 1950s; WillhiteWeb says removed in the 1950s. All three put the end in the same decade

notes_for_editor: The removal is dated only to the 1950s, so no removal event is recorded. Access comes from WillhiteWeb's 2022 directions; nothing read confirms current road or trail status. The public access level is an inference from that route description.
